newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Novartis completes Merck unit purchase.
newsitem.headline: Novartis completes Merck unit purchase.

text.p: Novartis AG said it closed the deal to acquire Merck & Co's crop protection business following the expiry of the statutory waiting periods in the U.S. without action from the Federal Trade Commission.
Novartis in May announced the $910 million purchase of the Merck business, which had 1996 sales of $200 million.

The acquisition strengthens its business in the high-value acaricide/insecticide and fungicide markets and includes the key products abamectin, sold primarily under the brand names Agri-Mek/Vertimec, Novartis said.
It also includes thiabendazole, brand named Mertect/Tecto and the the high-performance, low-dose insecticides in Merck's pipeline, the company added.
